<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Call the Hurricane](/Feats.aspx?ID=4274) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 32

</column>

---

Massive waves spiral around you, with you as the eye of the hurricane. The waves appear in a 20-foot emanation, or a 30-foot emanation if you're in a body of water. Each creature in the area takes 6d8 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. A creature that fails its save is battered by the waves and [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet (or 20 feet on a critical failure).

---
**Level (+2)** The damage increases by 1d8.
name: Call the Hurricane
